name: Plaisio Code

apps.name: Plaisio Code
apps.subtitle: Plaisio product lookup
apps.localizedDescription: Scan a barcode or search to find the Plaisio product code, price and store stock.
apps.versionDescription: Faster: code labels and shelf QR codes open sooner, barcodes the databases don't know are answered sooner, pictures stay loaded while scrolling, and a product's colours and sizes load together with its stock. Find in the stockroom uses less battery.

versions.localizedDescription: Faster: code labels and shelf QR codes open sooner, barcodes the databases don't know are answered sooner, pictures stay loaded while scrolling, and a product's colours and sizes load together with its stock. Find in the stockroom uses less battery.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan EAN barcodes to find the Plaisio product code.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns what you say into text to find it on the Chania shelf.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hold the microphone to say what a customer is looking for.
privacy.NFCReaderUsageDescription: Reads a shelf label's tag to set what it shows.
